## Q1 FY27 Results: LuxExperience with strong Net Sales growth of +8.5% ex-FX (+9.6% reported) and significantly improved Adjusted EBITDA profitability across all three segments in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26; Raising FY27 guidance


November 17, 2026


**KEY HIGHLIGHTS**


- **LuxExperience1 with strong top-line growth:** Net Sales increased +8.5% ex-FX (+9.6% reported at €610.5 million) in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- **Strong 430bps improvement in Adjusted SG&A cost ratio:** Decreased from 21.8% in Q1 FY26 to 17.6% in Q1 FY27, highlighting continued Adjusted SG&A reductions
- **Significant Adjusted EBITDA profitability expansion:** Adjusted EBITDA **** Margin **** improved by 590bps to 2.1% in Q1 FY27 vs. -3.9% in Q1 FY26
- **Accelerated outstanding top-line performance across all segments:** Net Sales ex-FX increased by +10.0% for Mytheresa, +7.2% for NAP & MRP and +8.2% for YOOX in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- **Significantly improved Adjusted EBITDA profitability across all segments:** More than doubled Adjusted EBITDA at Mytheresa, continued positive Adjusted EBITDA at NAP & MRP, and more than halved Adjusted EBITDA loss at YOOX in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- **Raised FY27 guidance:** LuxExperience increased its FY27 Adjusted EBITDA Margin guidance to 2.5% to 3.5% (prior: 2% to 3%) and narrowed its FY27 Net Sales growth guidance to +6% to +9% (prior: +MSD% to +HSD%) vs. FY26


MUNICH--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


LuxExperience B.V. (NYSE:LUXE) (the “Company”), today announced its financial results for its first quarter of FY 2027 ended September 30, 2026. The leading luxury multi-brand digital platform delivered strong top-line growth and a significant Adjusted EBITDA expansion in Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26, marking the fourth consecutive quarter of Adjusted EBITDA profitability. As a result of the strong performance in Q1 FY27, LuxExperience raised its full FY27 Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 2.5% to 3.5% and narrowed its full FY27 Net Sales growth guidance to +6% to +9% vs. FY26.


In Q1 FY27, Mytheresa demonstrated continued outstanding double-digit Net Sales ex-FX growth while more than doubling its Adjusted EBITDA compared to the prior-year period. NET-A-PORTER and MR PORTER delivered accelerated strong top-line growth in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 alongside strong Adjusted EBITDA profitability improvement, sustaining a positive Adjusted EBITDA Margin for the second consecutive quarter driven by a focus on full-price sales, customer engagement, and strict cost discipline. YOOX also delivered accelerated top-line growth in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 while more than halving its Adjusted EBITDA loss, driven by the focus on the healthy core of the business and continued streamlining of the operating model.


**Michael Kliger, Chief Executive Officer of LuxExperience** , said, “We are very pleased with our Q1 FY27 results as they show accelerated growth and continued profitability improvements outperforming the industry. Mytheresa continues to be the industry leader with double-digit growth and strong profitability, a success based on outstanding customer economics and a highly consistent business model. Our transformation of the acquired YNAP businesses continues to show remarkable results. NET-A-PORTER and MR PORTER delivered again strong top-line growth even above the very strong growth reported in Q4 FY26 vs. the previous year quarter and significantly improved Adjusted EBITDA results. Our off-price business YOOX delivered another outstanding quarter with accelerated top-line growth and again more than halved its Adjusted EBITDA loss compared to the previous year quarter.”


Kliger continued, “The results of the first quarter mark a great start into fiscal year 2027. We have again proven, that LuxExperience is the one and only digital destination for luxury enthusiasts worldwide delivering outstanding value for its customers and partners. Given the strongly improved top and bottom-line performance in the first months of fiscal year 2027, we are raising our Net Sales growth guidance to +6% to +9% and increasing our bottom-line guidance to an Adjusted EBITDA Margin of 2.5% to 3.5% for FY 2027.”


_____________________________________


1 Basis of Presentation:


(a) References to "LuxExperience" refers to LuxExperience B.V., including its consolidated subsidiaries." (b) Unless otherwise indicated, the financial and operating measures presented in this release are presented on a Total Segments basis. Total Segments represent the aggregate of the corresponding amounts for each of LuxExperience's reportable segments – Luxury Mytheresa, Luxury NAP & MRP, and Off-Price YOOX – and exclude "Other"


**FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS Q1 FY27** *Amounts in € million are reported figures unless stated otherwise.*


**LUXEXPERIENCE**


- Strong Net Sales growth of +8.5% ex-FX (+9.6% reported at €610.5 million) in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- Adjusted SG&A cost ratio improved significantly by 430bps from 21.8% in Q1 FY26 to 17.6% in Q1 FY27. In Q1 FY27, Adjusted SG&A expenses decreased €14.3 million or -11.1% compared to Q1 FY26
- Strong Adjusted EBITDA Margin improvement by 590bps to 2.1% in Q1 FY27 compared to -3.9% in Q1 FY26, marking the fourth consecutive quarter of positive Adjusted EBITDA. Adjusted EBITDA increased by €34.2 million to €12.7 million in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26


**LUXURY | MYTHERESA**


- Net Sales increased +10.0% ex-FX (+10.8% reported at €250.8 million) alongside continued Net Sales expansion in the United States of +9.0% ex-FX (+11.6% reported) in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- Gross Profit margin increased 160bps to 46.2%, driven by persistent focus on full-price sales in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- Adjusted EBITDA increased significantly by +128.1% or +€10.1 million, to €17.9 million in Q1 FY27, with Adjusted EBITDA Margin expanding 370bps to 7.1% in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26


**LUXURY | NAP & MRP**


- Net Sales were up +7.2% ex-FX (+8.8% reported at €231.0 million), driven by strong Net Sales growth in the United States of +24.3% ex-FX (+26.4% reported) in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- Continued high Gross Profit Margin at 47.7% in Q1 FY27, up 30bps from Q1 FY26, underlining focus on full-price sales and reduced discounting activities
- Adjusted SG&A cost ratio improved 560bps to 22.0% in Q1 FY27 compared to 27.6% in Q1 FY26 reflecting continued progress of the transformation plan
- Continued positive Adjusted EBITDA Margin, for two consecutive quarters, which significantly increased by 520bps to 0.3% in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 and Adjusted EBITDA was up +€11.0 million in Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26


**OFF-PRICE | YOOX**


- Net Sales grew +8.2% ex-FX (+8.4% reported at €128.6 million), driven by continued growth in Europe (excluding the U.K.) of +18.9% reported in Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26
- Adjusted SG&A cost ratio improved significantly by 890bps from 29.5% in Q1 FY26 to 20.6% in Q1 FY27. This equaled absolute cost savings of €8.5 million or a decrease by -24.2% of Adjusted SG&A expenses in Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26
- Adjusted EBITDA loss was more than halved and Adjusted EBITDA Margin improved significantly by 1,150bps to -4.6% in Q1 FY27 vs. -16.1% in Q1 FY26


**KEY BUSINESS HIGHLIGHTS**


**LUXURY | MYTHERESA**


- Improved customer economics in Q1 FY27: Top Customer count up +18.0%, Average Order Value (LTM) up +10.9% (reported) to €884 and Net Promoter Score (NPS) significantly up +640 bps to now 84.7 in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- 18 high-impact Top Customer activations and true “money can’t buy” experiences in Europe, the US and Asia
- Launch of 4 exclusive capsule collections and 10 exclusive pre-launches or exclusive styles campaigns


**LUXURY | NAP & MRP**


- Growth in Top Customers as a percentage of Total Customers in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 now at 10.2%, alongside strong increase in GMV per Top Customer of +11.7% and increase of Average Order Value (LTM) by +8.0% (reported) to €903 in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 and NPS increased to 62.7 in Q1 FY27 from 59.7 in Q4 FY26
- 18 editorial campaigns for exclusive brand and product pre-launches
- 7 unique EIP experiences at NET-A-PORTER and 10 unique EIP experiences at MR PORTER in the United States and Europe


**OFF-PRICE | YOOX**


- Strong growth in GMV per Top Customer of +23.8% and significant increase of the Net Promoter Score by +1,690bps to 51.7 in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26
- 14 community events across Europe leveraging key cultural moments


**LUXEXPERIENCE**


- Successful implementation of group-wide collaboration tools, migrating to Google Workspace
- Full roll out of group wide marketing messaging tool Braze also to Mytheresa fully on track for year end 2026
- Implementation of new buying and merchandising tools for NET-A-PORTER and MR PORTER in Q2 fully on track
- E-Commerce stack migration ahead of plan with launch on NET-A-PORTER and MR PORTER in summer 2027


**RAISED GUIDANCE FY 2027**


Following a strong start into the new fiscal year, LuxExperience is updating its guidance for the full fiscal year ending June 30, 2027. All segments delivered accelerated top-line growth and significant Adjusted EBITDA profitability improvements in Q1 FY27 compared to the prior-year period. Consequently, LuxExperience raised its FY27 Adjusted EBITDA Margin guidance and narrowed its FY27 Net Sales growth guidance. For our full fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, LuxExperience now expects


- Net Sales to grow by +6 % to +9% (prior: +MSD% to +HSD%) vs. FY26; and
- Adjusted EBITDA Margin at around 2.5% to 3.5% (prior: 2% to 3%)


LuxExperience reconfirms its medium-term annual growth rates of 10-15% and targets €4 billion Net Sales with an underlying Adjusted EBITDA margin of 7% to 9% medium-term. Following FY27 and until reaching this medium-term target, LuxExperience expects an annual 150 to 250bps increase in Adjusted EBITDA margin.


The foregoing forward-looking statements reflect LuxExperience’s expectations as of today's date. Given the number of risk factors, uncertainties and assumptions discussed below, actual results may differ materially. LuxExperience does not intend to update its forward-looking statements until its next quarterly results announcement, other than in publicly available statements.

**ABOUT NON-IFRS FINANCIAL MEASURES AND OPERATING METRICS**


Our non-IFRS financial measures and operating metrics include:


- **Adjusted EBITDA** means Net income (loss) from continuing operations before the effects of Finance income (costs), net, Income tax (expense) benefit and Depreciation, amortization and impairment losses, further adjusted to exclude other transaction-related, certain legal and other expenses, share-based compensation expense and foreign exchange gains and losses arising on intercompany balances. **Adjusted EBITDA Margin** means Adjusted EBITDA expressed as a percentage of Net sales. Both are non-IFRS financial measures and are not calculated in accordance with IFRS.
- **Adjusted selling, general and administrative expenses (Adjusted SG&A)** is a non-IFRS financial measure that we calculate as selling, general and administrative expenses adjusted to exclude Other transaction-related, certain legal and other expenses and Share-based compensation expense. For the reconciliation to Adjusted SG&A, refer to “Reconciliation of Net loss from continuing operations to Adjusted EBITDA” in the quarterly report for the three months ended September 30, 2026, on Form 6-K.
- **Gross Merchandise Value (GMV)** is an operative measure and means the total Euro value of orders processed. GMV is inclusive of merchandise value, shipping and duty. It is net of returns, value added taxes and cancellations. GMV does not represent revenue earned by us. We use GMV as an indicator for the usage of our platform that is not influenced by the mix of direct sales and commission sales. The indicators we use to monitor usage of our platform include, among others, active customers, total orders shipped and GMV.
- **Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) and Net Sales Growth on a constant currency basis (ex-FX)** are non-IFRS financial measures that are calculated by translating current period financial data at the prior year average exchange rates applicable to the local currency in which the transactions are denominated, including effects from hedge accounting. We use constant currency information to provide us with a picture of underlying business dynamics, excluding currency effect. These calculations do not include any other macroeconomic effect such as local currency inflation effects or any price adjustment to compensate local currency inflation or devaluations. While we believe that constant currency information may be useful to investors in understanding and evaluating our results of operations in the same manner as our management, our use of constant currency metrics has limitations as an analytical tool, and you should not consider it in isolation, or as an alternative to, or a substitute for analysis of our financial results as reported under IFRS. Further, other companies, including companies in our industry, may report the impact of fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates differently, which may reduce the value of our constant currency information as a comparative measure.


We are not able to forecast net income (loss) on a forward-looking basis without unreasonable efforts due to the high variability and difficulty in predicting certain items that affect net income (loss), including, but not limited to, Income taxes and Interest expense and, as a result, are unable to provide a reconciliation to forecasted Adjusted EBITDA or Adjusted EBITDA Margin.


**ABOUT LUXEXPERIENCE**


LuxExperience is the leading digital, multi-brand luxury group and the online shopping destination for luxury enthusiasts worldwide. LuxExperience operates a portfolio of some of the most distinguished store brands in digital luxury and creates communities for luxury enthusiasts with unique digital and physical experiences. Mytheresa, NET-A-PORTER and MR PORTER, jointly comprising the luxury segments of LuxExperience, offer highly curated edits of the most prestigious luxury brands across the world, featuring womenswear, menswear, kidswear, fine jewelry & watches, and lifestyle products. YOOX, which forms the off-price segment of LuxExperience, is the leading destination for multi-brand off-season online luxury shopping. The NYSE listed group operates worldwide.


For more information, please visit[https://investors.luxexperience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.luxexperience.com&esheet=54641943&newsitemid=20261117522788&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.luxexperience.com&index=5&md5=7abb5ca4c69b69e5fc863028b22ce497) .
